title: Tick Phase
description: Checklist with a phase-coloured tinted-ring tick marker and a divider between items, for the individual service pages (the marker and divider follow the page's phase via --ls-phase-accent). Typography, text colour, the list reset, item layout, divider, bold weight and the `ls-tick-phase--compact` className modifiers (`ls-tick-phase--compact` for tighter rows at smaller text, `ls-tick-phase--on-dark` for permanently-dark sections: phase on-dark accent and a translucent divider; set the list's text colour to text.on-dark with the block's own colour control) all live here; only the ::before tick marker is in src/scss/structural/tick-phase.scss, because a content:"" pseudo-element is on AGENTS.md's list of things a JSON style cannot express. Unlike Tick Accent, which is a solid brand-coloured circle.
